newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Trading in Draka, Twentsche Kabel suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Draka, Twentsche Kabel suspended.

text.p: Trading in Dutch cable makers Draka Holding NV and Twentsche Kabel NV were suspended on Monday until further notice.
A spokeswoman at Draka Holding said a news announcement would follow later today. "Probably at the end of the day," she said.
Draka Kabel's turnover was 1.26 billion guilders in 1996 and net profit was 80.7 million guilders.
Draka shares closed at 79.00 guilders last Friday.
Twentsche Kabel had annual turnover of 773 million guilders in 1996 and net profits were 54.3 million guilders.
Shares in Twentsche Kabel closed at 102.00 guilders last Friday.
